title: galium abaujense subsp. polonicum
intro: Galium abaujense subsp. polonicum, commonly known as Galium polonicum, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Rubiaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful for treating various ailments such as digestive issues and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Galium abaujense subsp. polonicum include its ability to act as a diuretic and a demulcent, helping to soothe and protect mucous membranes. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
